about: Speech benchmark for filler handling per engine. 'spoken' is what the speaker says, 'reference' is the text hush should insert, 'fillers' are the hesitation sounds in 'spoken'. Synthetic clips come from scripts/speech-benchmark-clips.sh (macOS voices); real recordings use the same ids as <id>.wav in a folder outside Git. Never edit a reference to make an engine look better.
